cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: There Is a Process
cards.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before I reassure you about the wedding, what precisely am I guaranteeing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Weather, marriage, or catering? They have different approval routes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One-time or renewable reassurance? I'll amend the request.

mechanism: A treats its wedding-anxious former pupil need for comfort as another exercise in specifying a request for documented approval, even when reassurance becomes a hug.
confusable: Not refusing affection outright: A keeps offering to process it only after its scope and duration are defined.
comparison: Emotional reassurance routed into forms versus urgent umbrella favor routed into loan terms.
